Bloomburst Puppets spend their days disguised as flowerbeds and potted plants, tucked away throughout the Censure Courts. Should a Tacet Discord wander too close, they unfold into Autopuppets and strike without warning.

After Suhsin the Inevitable threw the Capsule's order into disarray, the Bloombursts were corrupted by anomalies. Foliage inside grew uncontrollably from within: branches, leaves, and roots forcing out through every seam in their shells until finally splitting them open, leaving them in a half-machine, half-plant form.|Description When Discovered}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Bloomburst Puppet |zhs = 奇绽傀 |zht = 奇綻傀 |ja = 花咲かの奇傀 |ko = 기탄괴 |fr = Automate à floraison explosive |de = Blütenstoß-Puppe |es = Títere floral |th = Bloomburst Puppet |pt = Floro-Explosão }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.7}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
